text: Agents are autonomous units that perform tasks, make decisions, use tools, collaborate, maintain memory, and delegate
quote:
Perform specific tasks
* Make decisions based on its role and goal
* Use tools to accomplish objectives
* Communicate and collaborate with other agents
* Maintain memory of interactions
* Delegate tasks when allowed

text: Tasks are specific assignments with a description, responsible agent, and required tools
quote: a `Task` is a specific assignment completed by an `Agent`. Tasks provide all necessary details for execution, such as a description, the agent responsible, required tools

text: Crew process can run tasks sequentially or hierarchically
quote:
Sequential: Tasks are executed in the order they are defined
* Hierarchical: Tasks are as

text: Flows let you build structured, event-driven workflows that connect tasks, manage state, and control execution
quote: Flows allow you to create structured, event-driven workflows. They provide a seamless way to connect multiple tasks, manage state, and control the flow of execution in your AI applications.

text: Flows make it easy to manage and share state between tasks in a workflow
quote: Flows make it super easy to manage and share state between different tasks in your workflow.

text: Unified Memory class replaces separate short-term, long-term, entity, and external memory types with one API
quote: CrewAI provides a **unified memory system** -- a single `Memory` class that replaces separate short-term, long-term, entity, and external memory types with one intelligent API.

text: Memory system uses an LLM to infer scope/category/importance and retrieves via composite scoring of semantic similarity, recency, and importance
quote: Memory uses an LLM to analyze content when saving (inferring scope, categories, and importance) and supports adaptive-depth recall with composite scoring that blends semantic similarity, recency, and importance.

text: Tools give agents capabilities like web searching, data analysis, and delegating tasks to coworkers
quote: CrewAI tools empower agents with capabilities ranging from web searching and data analysis to collaboration and delegating tasks among coworkers.

text: Tools are skills/functions agents use, including built-in CrewAI Toolkit and LangChain Tools integrations
quote:
A tool in CrewAI is a skill or function that agents can utilize to perform various actions.
This includes tools from the [CrewAI Toolkit] and [LangChain Tools]

text: Integrates with multiple LLM providers via their native SDKs, letting you pick the model per use case
quote: CrewAI integrates with multiple LLM providers through providers native sdks, giving you the flexibility to choose the right model for your specific use case.

text: YAML config lets you version-control agent settings and easily switch between models
quote: The YAML configuration allows you to: * Version control your agent settings * Easily switch between different models

text: CrewAI CLI supports creating, training, running, and managing crews and flows
quote: The CrewAI CLI provides a set of commands to interact with CrewAI, allowing you to create, train, run, and manage crews & flows.

text: CLI can scaffold a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project
quote: Create a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project.

text: `crewai test` CLI command runs the crew for N iterations and reports performance metrics
quote: We added the CLI command `crewai test` to make it easy to test your crew. This command will run your crew for a specified number of iterations and provide detailed performance metrics.

text: `mcps` field on agents provides seamless MCP tool integration via string or structured config
quote: Use the `mcps` field directly on agents for seamless MCP tool integration. The DSL supports both **string references** (for quick setup) and **structured configurations** (for full control).

text: Performance monitoring tracks agent execution times, token usage, and resource consumption
quote: Track agent execution times, token usage, and resource consumption

text: Tracing & observability monitors and tracks agents/workflows in real time, including metrics, logs, and traces
quote: Tracing & Observability: Monitor and track your AI agents and workflows in real-time, including metrics, logs, and traces.

text: Visual Agent Builder lets you design and test agents with a no-code, form-based interface
quote: CrewAI AMP includes a Visual Agent Builder that simplifies agent creation and configuration without writing code. Design your agents visually and test them in real-time.

text: Visual Task Builder supports drag-and-drop task creation with visual dependencies and real-time testing
quote: CrewAI AMP includes a Visual Task Builder in Crew Studio that simplifies complex task creation and chaining. Design your task flows visually and test them in real-time without writing code.

text: Deploy crews to managed infrastructure with a few clicks and monitor execution in real time
quote: CrewAI AMP extends the power of the open-source framework with features designed for production deployments, collaboration, and scalability. Deploy your crews to a managed infrastructure and monitor their execution in real-time.

text: Deployed crews can be accessed via a REST API for integration with existing systems
quote: Access your deployed crews via REST API for integration with existing systems

text: Kickoff and status endpoints let you start a crew execution and poll its status
quote:
POST /kickoff](https://docs.crewai.com/edge/en/api-reference/kickoff.md): Start a crew execution
- [GET /status/{kickoff_id}](https://docs.crewai.com/edge/en/api-reference/status.md): Get execution status

text: Resume endpoint lets you resume crew execution with human feedback
quote: POST /resume](https://docs.crewai.com/edge/en/api-reference/resume.md): Resume crew execution with human feedback

text: Webhook streaming pushes real-time events and updates to your systems
quote:
Webhook Streaming

Stream real-time events and updates to your systems

text: Crew Studio offers a no-code/low-code interface to create and customize crews
quote:
Crew Studio

Create and customize crews using a no-code/low-code interface

text: Tool Repository lets you publish and install tools to extend crew capabilities
quote: Publish and install tools to enhance your crews' capabilities

text: Crews enable autonomous multi-agent collaboration while Flows give precise event-driven control
quote: It gives developers autonomous agent collaboration through Crews and precise, event-driven control through Flows.

text: A Crew is a collaborative group of agents working together with a defined strategy for task execution and collaboration
quote: A crew in crewAI represents a collaborative group of agents working together to achieve a set of tasks. Each crew defines the strategy for task execution, agent collaboration, and the overall workflow.

text: Setup prompt installs official CrewAI skills/docs for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor
quote: Copy a ready-to-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any coding agent. It installs the official CrewAI skills, checks the CLI, and points the agent at the right docs before it edits code.
